reviewMethod: Exact named OpenStreetMap feature, official operator guidance, and a destination-specific licensed campaign photograph. Features without all three were retained in the research queue rather than published.

skydance-bridge.name: Skydance Bridge
skydance-bridge.boundaryExceptionReason: Skydance Bridge is the official pedestrian connection between Scissortail Park's Upper and Lower parks and crosses Interstate 40 immediately beyond the reviewed Upper Park polygon.
skydance-bridge.summary: Skydance Bridge is a 380-foot pedestrian bridge and illuminated landmark inspired by Oklahoma's state bird; it links Scissortail Park's Upper and Lower parks across Interstate 40.
skydance-bridge.cost: Walking across Skydance Bridge is free; nearby parking, food, rentals, and ticketed park events can cost separately.
skydance-bridge.hours: The bridge is an outdoor pedestrian connection within the Scissortail Park campus. Plan around the park's daily 6:00 a.m.-11:00 p.m. hours and obey any closure or event-control signs at the approaches.
skydance-bridge.needToKnow: This is a through-route shared by people walking, running, and bicycling, not a roadside overlook. Stay on the pedestrian path, supervise children, keep the route clear when taking photos, and use the exact pin to find the Interstate 40 crossing between the Upper and Lower parks.

inasmuch-foundation-crystal-bridge-conse.name: Inasmuch Foundation Crystal Bridge Conservatory
inasmuch-foundation-crystal-bridge-conse.summary: The Inasmuch Foundation Crystal Bridge Conservatory is Myriad Botanical Gardens' ticketed indoor centerpiece, with tropical plant collections inside the cylindrical glass conservatory.
inasmuch-foundation-crystal-bridge-conse.cost: Conservatory admission is $10.50 for adults, $9 for seniors age 62 and older and military or veterans, $7 for students, and $5.50 for youth ages 5-17. Children age 4 and under and Myriad Gardens members enter free; group rates require advance reservations.
inasmuch-foundation-crystal-bridge-conse.hours: The Crystal Bridge is open Monday-Saturday 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. and Sunday 11:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. It is closed on Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day; programs or maintenance can change access.
inasmuch-foundation-crystal-bridge-conse.needToKnow: This indoor attraction has its own ticket and schedule even though the exterior gardens are free and remain open later. Individual visitors can buy admission on arrival. A loaner wheelchair is available free on a first-come basis with a driver's license, and only service animals are allowed inside the conservatory. Use the exact pin for the Crystal Bridge entrance rather than a general garden pin.

children-s-garden.name: Children's Garden
children-s-garden.summary: The Children's Garden is the family play area on the southwest side of Myriad Botanical Gardens, including imaginative outdoor spaces and the seasonal Thunder Fountain water-play area.
children-s-garden.cost: The outdoor Children's Garden and water features are free. The separate Crystal Bridge Conservatory, carousel rides, programs, parking, food, and special events can cost separately.
children-s-garden.hours: The Children's Garden follows the exterior grounds' daily 6:00 a.m.-11:00 p.m. schedule. The water features operate on a shorter seasonal schedule, listed by the Gardens as daily through Labor Day from 9:00 a.m.-9:00 p.m.; weather, maintenance, and seasonal shutdowns can interrupt water play.
children-s-garden.needToKnow: Bring a change of clothes and water shoes if Thunder Fountain is part of the plan, but confirm the water feature is operating before promising it to children. The splash area is seasonal and is not proof that every play feature is running. Leashed pets are allowed on the exterior grounds, recreational scooters cannot be ridden inside the Gardens, and mobility scooters are welcome.

water-stage.name: Water Stage
water-stage.summary: Water Stage is Myriad Botanical Gardens' outdoor amphitheater and floating-looking stage on the lagoon, paired with the West Plaza for performances, ceremonies, and gatherings.
water-stage.cost: Viewing the Water Stage during ordinary garden access is free. Reserving the venue, attending a ticketed event, nearby parking, food, and other services can cost separately.
water-stage.hours: The surrounding exterior grounds are normally open daily 6:00 a.m.-11:00 p.m. Event setup, private rentals, maintenance, weather, or crowd controls can restrict access to the stage and plaza even while the rest of the Gardens remains open.
water-stage.needToKnow: This is an active event venue beside open water, not a guaranteed public seating area at all times. Check the Gardens calendar and on-site signs before planning a quiet stop, keep children back from the lagoon edge, and use the exact pin to distinguish Water Stage from other lawns and performance spaces.

active-pool.name: Active Pool
active-pool.sourceLabel: Fort Worth Park and Recreation Department
active-pool.summary: The Active Pool is the Water Gardens' dramatic 38-foot-deep architectural basin, reached visually by descending table-topped steps beside rushing water.
active-pool.cost: General admission to Fort Worth Water Gardens and viewing the Active Pool are free; permitted private events and nearby parking can cost separately.
active-pool.hours: The Active Pool follows the Water Gardens' daily 6:00 a.m.-10:00 p.m. schedule unless maintenance, weather, a permitted event, or a safety closure restricts access.
active-pool.needToKnow: Swimming and wading are prohibited throughout the Water Gardens. The Active Pool approach is steep, wet, noisy, and visually disorienting for some visitors; use the upper viewpoints if stairs, balance, spray, or close supervision are concerns, and never cross barriers or enter the water.

quiet-pool.name: Quiet Pool
quiet-pool.sourceLabel: Fort Worth Park and Recreation Department
quiet-pool.summary: The Quiet Pool is a shaded, recessed reflecting pool framed by tall cypress trees and water walls near the Water Gardens' northwest entrance.
quiet-pool.cost: General admission to Fort Worth Water Gardens and viewing the Quiet Pool are free; permitted private events and nearby parking can cost separately.
quiet-pool.hours: The Quiet Pool follows the Water Gardens' daily 6:00 a.m.-10:00 p.m. schedule unless maintenance, weather, a permitted event, or a safety closure restricts access.
quiet-pool.needToKnow: Swimming and wading are prohibited, even though the setting is calm. Expect hard surfaces, steps, damp areas, and limited sightlines below street level; use the exact pin, keep children close, and follow posted barriers or maintenance closures.
